input.command:
cd /private/var/folders/kp/vdv61pd97vd0x29b257r8h7h0000gn/T/barcode-g8cgi4q2; cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-private-var-folders-kp-vdv61pd97vd0x29b257r8h7h0000gn-T-barcode-g8cgi4q2/13995def-6f0e-4427-b7f4-777a8146c5ca/scratchpad/c.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np,subprocess
from PIL import Image
b=np.array(Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB')).astype(float)[100]
N=200
def resample(a,n):
    idx=np.linspace(0,len(a)-1,n).astype(int);return a[idx]
bb=resample(b,N)
for L in 'ABCDEFGHIJ':
    out=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','quiet','-i',f'videos/{L}.mp4','-vf','fps=1,scale=1:1','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-'],capture_output=True).stdout
    v=np.frombuffer(out,np.uint8).reshape(-1,3).astype(float)
    vv=resample(v,N)
    print(L,len(v),np.abs(vv-bb).mean())
EOF

content.text:
The barcode matches option B, Luis Fonsi & Demi Lovato's "Échame la Culpa."

To check, I took one frame per second from each of the ten videos and shrank each frame to its average colour. I then lined each video's colour sequence up against the barcode at the same 200 points and measured how far apart the colours were, using the mean absolute difference per colour channel on a 0–255 scale (lower is a closer match).

| Option | Video | Difference |
|---|---|---|
| **B** | **Échame la Culpa** | **11.4** |
| G | Chantaje | 36.2 |
| I | Criminal | 37.7 |
| H | Miroshka TV – Learning Colors | 38.8 |
| D | Dura | 39.5 |
| C | Sin Pijama | 43.7 |
| A | Mayores | 46.0 |
| F | Calma (Remix) | 52.4 |
| E | X (Equis) | 59.3 |
| J | Dame Tu Cosita | 97.0 |

B's difference is less than a third of the next closest video's, so it's a clear match.

Answer: B
